prompt:
Edit the supplied 4-column, 2-row sprite sheet of the white-haired teal-clad RPG hero. This is a precise repair of the eight existing front-right/SE walking poses, not a new character or style.
Keep the same 4x2 order, fixed per-cell full-body registration, compact proportions and richly shaded small-game-sprite rendering. Every source cell is 128x128 and the complete source sheet is 512x256. Keep the sheet layout and empty transparent margins. The second reference is the same hero's appearance, not a pose to repeat.
Repair ONLY the charcoal trouser legs, knees, brown boot cuffs, calves and boot feet. Keep the existing head, face, hair, scarf, teal coat, belt, arms and gloves in the same positions. The finished sprites must still be about 96-100 pixels high on the original grid. Do not lengthen the torso or legs.
The current problem is inconsistent leg construction: the foot becomes a broad lump in one pose and a narrow vertical stump in another; cuff height and knee thickness jump. Give both legs stable physical size and softly rounded volume across ALL EIGHT frames. Each boot must retain the same cuff opening, shaft thickness, ankle connection, rounded forefoot and firm sole. A lifted foot can pitch at the ankle, but cannot shrink, stretch, turn into a different boot, merge with the other foot or disconnect from its own knee. The charcoal thighs must visibly connect from their own fixed hips under the coat, with plausible foreshortening and short soft folds. No long rod thighs or tall boots swallowing the knee.
Maintain a clear natural alternating WALK, not running, jumping, bicycling or standing with bouncing feet. Frame0: screen-right hip leg reaches forward, screen-left trails. Frame1: load that step, trailing foot releases. Frame2: opposite knee passes under its own hip, support leg mostly upright. Frame3: opposite leg reaches to its next contact while the old support heel releases. Frame4: opposite contact, screen-left hip leg forward and screen-right trails. Frame5: load and release. Frame6: screen-right knee passes under its hip with screen-left supporting. Frame7: screen-right leg reaches the next contact, joining smoothly back to frame0. Keep a small balanced stride, stable body height and the original view; do not mirror the whole hero. Preserve recognizable separate legs and boots even in passing poses.
Produce a single clean transparent 4x2 sheet of exactly eight fully drawn sprites. No extra poses, no text, labels, guides, ground, shadows, blur, speed lines or effects. Pixel-art-like shaded clusters, not vector outlines. This sheet will be sampled back to the source native grid and composited under the untouched original upper body.
